name: Lucas HEINTZMANN
headline: Learning to build innovative solutions through code.
intro: I'm a first-year student pursuing a Higher National Diploma (HND) in IT Services, specializing in Software Solutions and Business Applications (SLAM). Passionate about web development and building practical projects. Check out my work and skills.
bio: I'm a first-year student in the Higher National Diploma in IT Services program, specializing in Software Solutions and Business Applications. I'm passionate about web development and eager to learn new technologies to build innovative solutions.

Currently developing my skills in both front-end and back-end development, focusing on creating responsive, user-friendly web applications. My coursework includes programming, database management, and software architecture.
When I'm not studying or coding, I enjoy working on personal projects to apply what I've learned, exploring new frameworks and tools, and building my portfolio to showcase my growing expertise.
